entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Bar Confederation, a political institution in Poland during Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth (1700–1795). Grew from Jan III Sobieski's relief of the Siege of Vienna and Jan III. Led to the emergence of Kościuszko Uprising and Third Partition (1795) — Poland ceases to exist.
